desc: AccessRule: crud resource at /accounts/{account_id}/firewall/access_rules/rules/{rule_id}. Terraform equivalent: cloudflare_access_rule. Fields keep the API's own names.

spec.d: The configuration target. You must set the target to `ip` when specifying an IP address in the rule.
The IP address to match. This address will be compared to the IP address of incoming requests.
The action to apply to a matched request.
The Connection to use; default "default" in the same namespace.
Fill body fields from Secrets: {<field>: {name, key}}. Use for tokens, passwords and secret values.

Fill spec fields from other objects in this namespace: {<field>: {kind, name, fieldPath}}. fieldPath defaults to status.id, taken once that object is Ready; apiVersion is needed only where the kind's name is in more than one group. Nothing is sent until every reference resolves.

example.yaml:
apiVersion: access.cloudflare.hfl.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AccessRule
metadata:
  name: example-accessrule
  namespace: default
spec:
  accountID: <accountId>
  mode: challenge
  configuration:
    target: ip
    value: 192.0.2.77
  notes: example-accessrule
example.line: Tested live: create, update, drift repair and delete passed against Cloudflare free account (Free Website zone) on 2026-11-20.
